candidates.snippet: An attempt by murderer Erin Patterson, who killed three people with a meal of toxic mushrooms, to overturn her conviction has failed, with an appeals court finding that her original sentence was too light for her "cold and calculated" crimes. https://t.co/rYOhCE0LOP https://t.co/
